item.title: ‘Bond 26’: Denis Villeneuve Wants An “Unapologetic” James Bond, Won’t Change 007’s DNA & Expected A Casting “Hurricane”
item.description: Having spent the better part of a decade immersed in the dense mythology of Frank Herbert’ s “ Dune ,” filmmaker Denis Villeneuve sounds positively giddy about moving on to James Bond. And while there’s understandably a lot of curiosity about what the director’s particular sensibilities will bring to “Bond 26,” starring Robert Pattinson , Villeneuve seems less interested in deconstructing 007 than embracing the qualities that have made the character enduringly popular for more than six decades. item.title: ‘War’ Season 2 Teaser: Marisa Tomei & Kelly Macdonald Face Off In HBO’s Legal Drama
item.description: New clients, new grievances, same lawyers. Following its first-season finale, HBO has released a teaser for season two of “ War ,” the London-set legal drama from creator George Kay (“Lupin,” “Hijack”). With Dominic West and Sienna Miller ’s divorce proceedings behind them, the show’s rival law firms take on a new dispute involving Oscar winner Marisa Tomei and Kelly Macdonald . HBO and Sky ordered two seasons of “War” from the outset, allowing Kay to develop a quasi-anthology that follows the lives of its lawyers through a different high-profile case each season.
